message.abstract: <jats:p>This paper proposes a novel method for local feature description. Unlike most descriptors only encode the spatial information of one neighborhood of sample point, we propose a novel method to encode more than one local feature for each sample point. Based on our proposed method, two local descriptors: MIOP (Multi-neighborhood Intensity Order Pattern) and MIROP (Multi-neighborhood Intensity Relative Order Pattern) are presented in the paper. Thanks to the rotation invariant coordinate system, our proposed descriptors are built without reference orientation estimation. To evaluate the performance our descriptors and other existing descriptors (e.g. SIFT, LIOP, DAISY, HRI-CSLTP, MROGH), image matching experiments and object recognition experiments were conducted on Oxford dataset and additional image pairs with drastic illumination changes. The experimental results show that our proposed local descriptors exhibit better performance than other evaluated descriptors.</jats:p>
title: A Robust Method for Constructing Rotational Invariant Descriptors
